caption:
Google banned your review script.

Google's April 2026 Rating Manipulation policy update added two new rules: no staff review quotas, and no coaching a customer to name a specific employee in their review.

Same technician's name, same day, same pattern. Google's detection flags it, and real reviews start disappearing alongside the fake ones.

The fix: take the ask off the counter. Send one text after the job closes, with no script to repeat. Let the customer describe what happened in their own words.

Black Arrow's platform sends that request the moment a job closes.

rationale: Google's April 2026 Rating Manipulation update added two explicit rules banning staff review quotas and coached staff-name mentions in reviews, a fresh compliance-risk angle tied directly to Black Arrow's review-engine capability, distinct from every prior review-timing, gated-workflow, and AI-discovery angle already shipped.
